Subject: Post-demo recap: decision criteria, legal/procurement path & internal pitch kit

Hi Anna — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (30-minute demo)
- Showed low-latency EHR summarization flow and embedding-based search for care teams.
- Discussed data residency and optional VPC/private deployment for PHI workloads.
- Identified two potential pilots: inpatient discharge notes automation (clinical ops) and prior authorization triage (revenue ops).

Decision criteria you mentioned
1) Security & compliance: SOC2 + encryption-in-transit & at-rest; support for customer KMS.
2) Integration effort: connectors to Epic/Custom API and ability to run inference in Aurora VPC.
3) Unit economics: target per-call cost target and latency SLOs for 95th pct.
4) Executive buy-in: ROI estimate for 3-month pilot showing >1.5x efficiency uplift for clinician time.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Could you share the legal and procurement contacts to loop in (we can send an MSA + a short risk FAQ)?
- Would Procurement be available for a 30-min sync next week to review pricing and contracting timeline?
- I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a short post-demo recap PDF.

Attachments: Logan_Redwood_PostDemo_Recap.pdf, Aurora_Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Happy to adjust the MAP based on your inputs — proposed times for procurement call (PST): Tue 11/18 10:00, Wed 11/19 11:00, Thu 11/20 09:00. What works best?

Thanks again — excited about the pilot opportunity.

—

Subject: Internal: Champion enablement pack + quick talk tracks for Adrian / execs

Folks — putting together a compact enablement bundle for Adrian and the exec sponsor. Draft talk tracks and ROI bullets below (I'll attach the talk-tracks PDF and a short one-slide ROI calc). Please review and flag edits.

Suggested internal pitch flow for Adrian (1-2 min):
- Problem statement: Clinicians spend X hrs/week on manual prior auth and discharge documentation; this creates backlogs and impacts throughput.
- Why Redwood: We run inference with enterprise security, provide VPC deployment, and can deliver a pilot with measurable clinician-time savings and low operational overhead.
- Low-risk pilot: 8-week pilot in a single service line, pre/post clinician time study, rollout gating on privacy & integration checklist.

ROI bullets (for execs)
- Expected clinician time savings: 1.2–2.0 hrs/day per clinician for targeted workflows (conservative estimate).
- Financial proxy: $Xk saved per clinician per month at average fully-burdened clinician cost.
- Payback: Pilot breakeven expected within 2–3 months if throughput targets met.

Security/Procurement prep (what to send them immediately)
- SOC2 report (latest) + brief on KMS options (customer-managed KMS supported).
- Short Q&A doc answering common procurement questions (data retention, logs, access controls).
- MSA redline we can share; call out indemnity/limitation items to expect.

Attachments I'll drop into the thread: Redwood_Internal_Champion_Talk_Tracks.pdf (1 pager), one-slide ROI calc.

If you want, I can be on the procurement call as the technical/ops reviewer.

—
Monica Patel
